mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the rule on Tuesday's unseen cases was most worthwhile: it exposed a concrete wrongful refusal before deployment and gave the later human-review change a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the talkbox parts was straightforward but less engaging as a sequence of only-offered combinations, despite the appealing character and accessibility details.

surprise.text: Changing the refusal rule meant Tuesday's score no longer described it, making a fresh Wednesday test necessary.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the talkbox assembly offered little meaningful choice because each part was the only combination offered.

continue.text: Yes. The concrete failure, human-review fix and fresh test made me curious how the dispatch system would fare in use, even if the assembly sequence was predictable.
